## 🗂️ v1.1.0.4 — Count each playback, limit transcodes per user

Install it from **Dashboard → Plugins** (your server picks the right build), then restart Jellyfin. Both new options are **off by default**: nothing changes on your server until you turn them on.

| Jellyfin server | Version | File |
|---|---|---|
| 10.11.0 → 10.11.x | `1.1.0.4` | `StreamLimit-v1.1.0.4.zip` |
| 12.0 → 12.x | `1.1.1.4` | `StreamLimit-v1.1.0.4-jellyfin12.zip` |

### ✨ New
- **Count each playback, not each device** *(Blocking tab, beta)*. Browser tabs share one device id, and Jellyfin merges them into one session, so by default several tabs count as one stream. Turn this on and each playback counts — it also covers several machines sending a copied device id. A quality switch or the next episode is never refused: a playback is only refused once it really overlaps another one, which takes about 5 to 10 seconds for a second browser tab.
- **Video transcodes at once, per user** *(Blocking tab)*. Caps how many video transcodes one account can run at the same time, whatever its stream limit and devices, so one account cannot saturate your server's encoder. Over the limit, the newest transcode is stopped. Direct play, remux and audio are not counted. Works even with the hard block turned off; administrators follow *Never limit administrators*.
- **Several playbacks on one device in the live view.** Two tabs of one browser now show as two playbacks under the device, each with its title, start time and whether it transcodes — and how many streams they count for.

### 🐛 Fixes
- **A blocked browser tab stops at once.** The web popup now pauses the video and closes the player, instead of letting the tab play the minute of video it had already downloaded. The player's automatic retries right after a block are answered in the tab itself, so they no longer start a server transcode for nothing.
- A refused playback is checked again after 30 seconds: a client that keeps retrying plays again as soon as the user has freed a stream.

### 📝 Docs
- README rewritten tab by tab, with fresh screenshots of the settings page.

### 🔧 Under the hood
- Verified end to end on **Jellyfin 12.3** in a real browser (two tabs of one browser, quality switch / restart in the allowed tab, transcode limit), plus the full test suite on both builds.

### 📦 Install
Add the repository in **Dashboard → Plugins → Repositories**, then install **StreamLimiter** from the catalog:
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JellyboxAD/Jellyfin.Plugin.StreamLimit/main/manifest.json
```

> [!TIP]
> If the plugin shows *NotSupported* after updating: uninstall it, restart, reinstall it from the catalog and restart again. Your limits and settings are kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/JellyboxAD/Jellyfin.Plugin.StreamLimit/compare/v1.1.0.3...v1.1.0.4
